entities.name: PMID:27493268
observations: 2017 Journal of Nuclear Medicine study used 111In-labeled E. coli asparaginase, SPECT/CT, biodistribution, macrophage depletion, and cell models to study clearance.

entities.name: Asparaginase
observations: In mice, radiolabeled E. coli asparaginase rapidly accumulated in macrophage-rich bone marrow, liver, and spleen; liposomal clodronate depletion reduced uptake and prolonged serum half-life.

entities.name: Macrophage clearance of asparaginase
observations: In C57BL/6 mice, imaging and biodistribution showed rapid asparaginase accumulation in bone marrow; phagocyte depletion reduced uptake in macrophage-rich organs and prolonged serum half-life. Macrophage cathepsin B contributed to degradation.
